<translate>
'''Majin Buu''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House|Majin Buu's House]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Unlike most masters he teaches no plain skills, only three techniques of his own: one ki attack, one strike and one evasion technique. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Buu lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House|Majin Buu's House]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Every tier-5 Capsule Corp Assistant sells a map to it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House#Finding it|Majin Buu's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Ki attack:''' Assault Rain
* '''Strike attacks:''' Gum Punch, Mystic Ball Attack
* '''Evasion technique:''' Sleep Recovery
</translate>

<translate>
They're paid for with Training Points. Anyone can learn them, but only Majins can equip Gum Punch, the Mystic Ball Attack and Sleep Recovery (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]]). His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>
